title: Netcore Unbxd
description: netcoreunbxd.com Netcore Unbxd AI product-discovery platform for enterprise e-commerce: smart site search, 1:1 personalization, recommendations, visual intelligence ("Complete the Look"), catalog enrichment, and — its 2026 bet — a Shopping Agent (agentic commerce). Owned by India's Netcore Cloud since March 2022 (~$100M deal, 90%), run by founders Pavan Sondur and Prashant Kumar; SaaS sits on composable, API-first infra (Cloudflare, Kubernetes, multi-region), with <10ms response on 95% of queries and 35M documents processed monthly. Recognition: Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader 3 years running, highest "Current Offering" score in Forrester Wave Q3 2025, 7 G2 badges Summer 2025. Claimed customer results (self-reported): +38% AOV, +28% conversion, −60% null searches, −53% bounce. Positioning is sharply anti-native-search and anti-generic-AI, aimed at retail merchandisers with no-code workbenches and full override control. Site's main CTA is a free "personalized site experience audit."
